title: Valid Boolean-list suffixes
statement: For a state $q\in\{0,1,2,3,4,5\}$ and a Boolean list $x$, define the suffix condition as follows. At state $0$, $x$ is the serialization of some CNF formula over $\mathbb N$; at state $1$, it is the serialization of a clause followed by the serialization of a CNF formula. At state $2$, it consists of $v$ true entries, then false and a Boolean $b$, followed by a serialized clause and a serialized CNF formula, for some $v\in\mathbb N$; at state $3$, it consists of a Boolean $b$ followed by a serialized clause and a serialized CNF formula. At state $4$, $x$ is empty, and at state $5$ the condition is false.
